title: A River Becoming: system map
about: Every machine, device, service and connection of A River Becoming, for people and agents. Source of truth for docs/system/index.html (interactive) and docs/system/system.md (generated by tools/system_docs.py). Validated by tools/tests/test_system_json.py. Optional display fields: node.short (diagram name) and link.label (text on the arrow).
rules: Everything except secrets: names, hostnames, LAN and Tailscale IPs, ports, usernames and account emails are in; passwords and token values never (Gavin, 18 Oct).
Secrets appear only by name and where they live.
The river site is given as an area only.

Never advertise a site's own LAN as a Tailscale subnet from another device: it hijacks bitcube's local traffic (18 Oct, when the GL.iNet's 10.0.7.0/24 route took the gallery cam and the eero away from bitcube).
verified: confirmed = checked on the device, in code, or by the team; unverified = believed but not checked; awaiting:<Name> = needs that person's answer.

medium.xlr: 4-pin XLR, 24 V + SPI data to a rope
medium.video: HDMI, USB-C display, Colorlight and HUB75 video chain
medium.lan: a local network (Wi-Fi or Ethernet) at a site
medium.git: git pushes, Pages builds, GitHub Actions

scenarios.name: Now: Agape
scenarios.summary: Prototype at Agape. bitcube runs the local rain checkpoint on 18 of 20 ropes and HUB75 quad 1, with no Modal input yet. The gallery cam is on Agape WiFi, and bitcube shares it on Will's tailnet (10.0.7.76/32). The GL.iNet router and the river cam left for the river with Casper on the evening of 18 Oct. Modal's agent ticks every 5 minutes, but nothing on bitcube reads it yet.

scenarios.name: Show: Gray Area
scenarios.when: install from Wed 22 Oct 2026, show to 27 Oct
scenarios.summary: Planned and partly unsettled. bitcube and all lighting move to Gray Area: lighting NIC on a switch to the rack and PSAC10s, internet from the gallery network on the other NIC or Wi-Fi. The gallery cam joins the gallery Wi-Fi and bitcube advertises its address on Will's tailnet, as at Agape. bitcube mirrors Modal's scene (sync.py, :8770) and pushes gallery clips to /ingest. The river cam is at the river on Starlink.

places.name: The River
places.summary: The real river the agent watches. The GL.iNet router and the Reolink E1 Outdoor Pro went there with Casper on 18 Oct; Starlink and solar/battery power are expected there (unverified).
notes: Location given as an area only, on purpose: the kit there is unattended.

services.name: TouchDesigner 2025.33230
services.detail: Non-Commercial licence (TOPs max 1280x1280). Login autostart Start-River.cmd (10 s) opens river-local-oct-18.toe, the local rain checkpoint. river.toe is the general show file for Dave's visuals.

services.name: Art-Net sender
services.detail: td/ropes/artnet_out.py inside TD: 40 fps target (about 35 sent), brightness 0.4 cap, 600 W per box limiter. Byte-identical to Will's RopeLights. Keeps sending black to keep the ropes dark.

services.name: HUB75 window
services.detail: /project1/panels: a black 1920x1080 window on the LED display (found by EDID name), panel atlas pinned at its top-left (quad 1 at 0,0; quad 2 at 256,0). In river-local-oct-18.toe a gain stage brightens quad 1 (Panelgain 3.0, Panelgamma 0.7, panels Brightness 1.0; 18 Oct 17:55).

services.name: Claude bridge
services.detail: td/bridge: WebServer DAT on :9980, POST /exec, GET /errors, GET /screenshot. `tools\td.ps1` uses it.

services.name: RopeLights (Will)
services.detail: Scheduled task RopeLights, no trigger. Never run it while TD sends Art-Net.

services.name: RiverSnapshot
services.detail: Scheduled task: every 15 min, 08:00 to 02:00, a 640x360 gallery-cam still force-pushed to branch snapshot.

services.name: Status page at login
services.detail: Start-Status.cmd (40 s): Chrome on the M14 with the public status page (local docs if offline).

services.name: Claude Code at login
services.detail: Start-Claude.cmd (20 s): Windows Terminal in C:\Users\user\River running Claude.

services.name: gallery/sync.py mirror

nodes.name: river-agent app
nodes.summary: Dave's Modal app: a cron tick (one agent step every 5 min), a watch function (one per camera clip), and the web function serving the page, /data and /ingest.

specs.watch: spawned by /ingest for each mp4 clip; asks Clef-Omni the agent's questions; writes reflex.json
specs.web: FastAPI (ASGI), scales to zero, up to 50 concurrent requests
specs.model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash
specs.deploy: GitHub Actions on push to main of drocamor/river-agent
specs.live_18_oct: tick 3356, mood expansive, scene flow / dry-bones, lifetime errors 0

nodes.name: GET /data/{file}
nodes.summary: The live files: status.json, state.json, pad.json, journal_recent.json, reflex.json (+ scenes.jsonl, journal.jsonl). bitcube's mirror will pull these every 3 s.

specs.auth: none today (SITE_TOKEN not set); with SITE_TOKEN: cookie river_token

nodes.name: POST /ingest/{location}/{channel}
nodes.summary: Where sensors push media: Authorization: Bearer <INGEST_TOKEN>. An mp4 to channel video starts the watch loop.

nodes.name: GET /canvas.html
nodes.summary: The sculpture alone, full window, for TouchDesigner's Web Render TOP. ?w=&h= sets the design area (default 480x270).

specs.polls: status.json every 3 s, state.json on change (or every 30 s), reflex.json every 2 s

nodes.name: GET / (journal page)
nodes.summary: The installation's page: the sculpture, a status strip and the agent's journal. Kiosk mode ?kiosk=1. /healthz answers {"ok": true}.

nodes.name: Volume river-agent-data
nodes.summary: The agent's state: journal.jsonl, status.json, state.json, scenes.jsonl, pad.json, journal_recent.json, reflex.json, media/<location>/<channel>/<time>.<ext>.

specs.retention: media 72 h; video clips 1 h; gallery frames 1 h (visitors)

api.summary: Modal composes, bitcube renders. Every 5 minutes the agent's tick writes a scene (state.json) and status; between ticks, camera reflexes nudge the scene's knobs (reflex.json). bitcube never renders on Modal: it mirrors these small JSON files locally (gallery/sync.py on 127.0.0.1:8770) and draws the scene itself (canvas.html in TouchDesigner's Web Render TOP, sampled onto the ropes and HUB75), so the show keeps its last scene through an outage. In the other direction, bitcube pushes 10 s camera clips to /ingest with a bearer token. Nothing on Modal connects into bitcube or the tailnet.

contract.item: bitcube pulls /data/state.json, reflex.json and status.json (plus pad.json and journal_recent.json) every 3 s through the gallery/sync.py mirror, served on 127.0.0.1:8770 (8765 is RopeLights).
contract.note: The code supports it (--port 8770 --every 3). Dave to OK running it on bitcube (open question).

contract.item: File names, fields and meanings below.
contract.note: From river-agent a9cbd2c and the live site.

contract.item: If Modal or the internet is down, the mirrored files stop changing: the last scene keeps playing; evolution resumes when the link returns.
/data and the page need no token today. If Dave sets SITE_TOKEN, sync.py sends it as the river_token cookie (--token).
bitcube pushes gallery-cam clips: POST /ingest/gallery/video, Content-Type video/mp4, Authorization: Bearer <INGEST_TOKEN>, 10 s each, back to back (capture.py --video).
contract.note: Needs INGEST_TOKEN, and Dave's confirmation of location/channel names and cadence.

contract.item: River clips: POST /ingest/river/video from whichever capture agent reaches the river cam.
TouchDesigner renders http://127.0.0.1:8770/canvas.html?w=<w>&h=<h> in a Web Render TOP and samples it onto the ropes and HUB75 with the camera pixel map.
contract.note: Design size (w x h) for 20x400 ropes + panels: open question.

endpoints.auth: None today. With SITE_TOKEN set: cookie river_token=<SITE_TOKEN> (set once by opening any page with ?token=...).

responses.404: not a served file, or not written yet (state.json is never 404: a placeholder scene is served)

params.location: lowercase name matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$; questions are asked only for gallery and river
params.channel: same pattern; video for mp4 clips (fast perception); camera, microphone, hydrophone for frames and WAVs; any other name for JSON readings
params.ext: optional ?ext= when the content type is unknown

endpoints.body: The file. Content-Type one of image/jpeg, image/png, audio/wav, audio/flac, audio/ogg, audio/mpeg, video/mp4, application/json. Max 25 MB. A JSON reading must be an object with a non-empty summary.
endpoints.stores: media/<location>/<channel>/<YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM-SS-mmmZ>.<ext> on the Volume; video kept 1 h, other media 72 h. An mp4 spawns watch() (one at a time, in order).

400.error: location and channel must be short lowercase names

415.error: unknown content type 'text/plain'; send image/jpeg, audio/wav, application/json, or ?ext=

json_reading_example.summary: Water is 11.2 C, down 0.3 since the morning.

params.h: design height, default 270 (w x h is an area; the design takes the window's shape)

endpoints.note: Draws the scene client-side at the window's device pixels; polls status.json every 3 s, state.json on a new tick (or every 30 s), reflex.json every 2 s. Never blank: falls back to a default scene.

files.name: status.json
files.written_by: tick, at the start (in_progress) and end of every tick

fields.next_tick_epoch: when the next tick is due
fields.acted: the tools the agent called this tick
fields.sensors: per site_channel: present, file, age_s, fresh
fields.in_progress: null, or set while a tick runs

files.name: state.json
files.written_by: tick, when the agent calls set_visual_scene
files.poll: on a new tick (or every 30 s)

fields.seq: int, +1 per change (apply only when it changes)
fields.set_at / set_at_epoch: when it was set (used to ease)
fields.scene.animation: drift | flow | ripples | aurora | embers | waves | blooms | pulse

files.name: reflex.json
files.written_by: watch, every few seconds while a camera is answering

fields.ttl_seconds: ignore the file once older than this (default 90)
fields.offsets: brightness, speed, density, turbulence; each clamped to +-0.25, added to the scene's knobs
fields.sites: last reading per site (epoch or null)

files.name: pad.json

fields.state: chord, notes (MIDI), colour (plain|seventh|suspended|open|add9), register (low|middle|high), voices, intensity
fields.events: timed voice moves: expression / on / off at absolute epochs

files.note: The installation will probably have no sound.

fields.entries: oldest first: tick, timestamp, reflection, mood_word, auto_generated, context

mirror.writes: atomic (tmp + rename), only when a file changed
mirror.on_failure: keeps the last files; logs the 1st, 10th and every 100th failure; backs off
